nuggets.text: Pistol Pete is modeled on a real man, Frank Eaton, whom students spotted leading a Stillwater parade around 1923.
Bullet the horse gallops onto the field after every Cowboys touchdown, a tradition dating to 1984.
Drew Mestemaker never started a varsity game in high school, then walked on at North Texas and led the nation in passing yards.
Eric Morris was Texas Tech's offensive coordinator while Patrick Mahomes played quarterback there.
Eric Morris played receiver for Mike Leach at Texas Tech, where his small stature earned him the nickname "the Elf."
Wyoming and New Mexico State have both used variations of the Cowboys' Pistol Pete artwork as their own logos.
The Cowboys have 91 new faces on their 2026 roster.
Barry Sanders learned he had won the 1988 Heisman Trophy while in Tokyo with the Cowboys for a game against Texas Tech.
Boone Pickens Stadium runs east to west, the only stadium in the Big 12 laid out that way.
Caleb Hawkins rushed for 1,400 yards and 25 scores at North Texas before joining the Cowboys.
